texts.text:
The clearing has not emptied. The assembly lingers in uneven rings, their Weave-Script flickering with the weight of what they just witnessed.

Seren remains kneeling at the center, composed, her aqua skin catching the last light. The presiding Dohkar steps forward.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "This rite is mine to preside, and what the Sacrificiant did in it is mine to rule on."

His voice carries without effort. The assembly straightens around him.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "In a preliminary review, before this assembly."

The words land like a seal pressed into wax. My standing, the path my father walked, shifts visibly in the eyes of every witness.

Julian has not moved from the edge, yet the assembly has already made room for him.

His stillness is the only thing that can make the Dohkar's gaze sharpen.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "The review will be recorded. The Sacrificiant will answer for her conduct."

The assembly's attention tightens around me. Seren's mother is still on her feet.

Julian's gaze finds mine across the clearing. He does not speak, but the room has already adjusted to his presence.

The Dohkar's Weave-Script flares hard and flat.

THE PRESIDING DOHKAR: "This will be settled before witnesses. The record will stand."

My standing fractures in the open air. The path I never imagined not walking narrows to a single recorded line.

Julian's presence changes what the room believes is possible. The Dohkar notices.

The deck is still in my hand. The gold edges catch the failing light.

One of the heavy gold cards slips out.

I realize that old tarot deck is still in my hand. Reassuringly solid. Present. One of the heavy gold cards slips out — “Petition Fate” is inscribed in it.

oas.pcSay: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.pcSayRaw: I shaped nothing. Ask me properly.
oas.liDialogue: You shaped the rite with every tilt of your gaze toward me. Did you call my name hoping I would step forward and claim the moment as yours?
oas.liAction: Julian's scarred fingers stay closed over mine on the double-ended shaft.

oas.pcDo: I stand still, the tension thickening the air between us.
oas.pcDoRaw: Stand still, letting the tension fill the air
oas.liDialogue: Your breath betrays the call you sent. You shaped the rite with every glance toward me, hoping I would step forward and claim the moment as yours.
oas.liAction: Julian's scarred fingers press the Answer deeper into my palm.

oas.pcSay: I will not answer your questions in this place, not in this way.
oas.pcDo: I step back, drawing my hand from his grip on the shaft.
oas.pcSayRaw: I won't answer your questions here, not like this.
oas.pcDoRaw: Step back, pulling my hand away from his grip
oas.liDialogue: The Answer will reveal itself regardless of your choice. Your retreat alters nothing.
oas.liAction: Julian's weathered hand lingers in the air for a heartbeat after letting go.

oas.pcDo: I stand still, letting the tension fill the air between us.

oas.liDialogue: Each look you cast my way during the ceremony resonated more than any spoken vow. Did you think I’d stride in and seize the occasion?
oas.liAction: Julian's jaw tightens as his hand lingers in the air after letting go.

oas.pcDo: I stand still, letting the tension fill the air between us.
oas.pcDoRaw: Stand still, letting the tension fill the air
oas.liDialogue: The truth rests weighty in your palm. Your quiet pulls all attention nearer.
oas.liAction: Julian's eyes lock onto mine, unwavering.
